title: FANGS IN THE CRAGS // THE BURNED MEN STRIKE
narrative: As the royal procession wound through the sheer gorge below the Eyrie, fifty Burned Men and Moon Brothers leaped from the rocky heights, riding half-tamed shadowcats with eyes like pale embers. Ser Harrold Hardyng drew his sword, shouting for the knights of the Vale to form a circle around Alayne's litter. Steel clashed against stone as shadowcats tore through pack mules and barded destriers with ferocious shrieks. Harry fought with reckless valor, parrying an iron morningstar and impaling a clan chieftain through the breastplate, splattering Sansa's velvet gown with crimson mountain snow.
resolvesPlotHole: The Threat of the Mountain Clans of the Vale
